753:t_217:2.en:

753:t_217:4.en:

753:t_217:6.en:

753:t_217:7.en:
$$ベック$$

「$$ノノ$$ will go shopping with Big Sis, eat yummy food with Big Sis, go traveling with Big Sis, see swans...」

753:t_218:14.en:

「Anyway! There's no way $$ノノ$$ will let someone like you get in the way of her life plan!」

753:t_218:15.en:

「Anyway! There's no way $$ノノ$$ will let someone like you get in the way of her life plan!」

753:t_218:16.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Anyway! There's no way $$ノノ$$ will let someone like you get in the way of her life plan!」

753:t_218:17.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「How pitiful... If the universe perishes, all of those dreams will come to nothing...」

753:t_218:18.en:

758:t_1:4.en:
$$エスター$$
「So the $$ソーラリアン$$'s refit is finished.」

758:t_1:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ vanished along with $$ＡＧ$$, but the ship can still do a fair amount of event control. New work is waiting for it, too.」

758:t_1:7.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「The new $$天柱$$ born near Earth that connects the parallel worlds, and the gate to control it...」

758:t_1:8.en:
$$エスター$$
「So if we go through it, we can travel to all sorts of parallel worlds.」

758:t_1:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right. That's exactly what the new world born from that $$時空修復|lc$$ looks like...」

758:t_1:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「I call it the hyperdimensional world.」

758:t_1:11.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「So humanity from now on will spread not only into outer space, but into the parallel worlds as well.」

758:t_1:12.en:
$$エスター$$
「It looks like we'll get to see everyone in $c who went back to their own worlds again, much sooner than I thought.」

758:t_1:13.en:
$$トライア$$
「Having said that, it's still a state where only the theory is running ahead.」

758:t_1:14.en:
$$トライア$$
「Never mind worlds that are relatively close to each other, making contact with every parallel world isn't going to be that easy.」

758:t_1:15.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「That's why we need people who will go through the gate and open up new worlds, I take it.」

758:t_1:16.en:
$$トライア$$
「According to the info from $$ツィーネ$$ at the Gate Management Bureau, folks in every world have been thinking the same thing, and access keeps pouring in from all of them.」

758:t_1:17.en:
$$エスター$$
「So the $$サイデリアル$$ was dismantled too, and the soldiers all went back to their own worlds.」

758:t_1:18.en:
$$トライア$$
「I got word from $$サルディアス$$ the other day. With the $$御使い$$s gone, the $$サイデリアル$$ soldiers were freed too, and thanks to that, the fighting has vanished from the galaxy...」

758:t_1:19.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well... he did say he didn't know how long the peace would last, though.」

758:t_1:20.en:
$$エスター$$
「That old guy... he just had to say something unnecessary right to the end...」

758:t_1:21.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「What will overturn that is the effort of the humans who overcame the fighting.」

758:t_1:22.en:
$$トライア$$
「At the very least, the world will change. ...Beyond the stars, beyond dimensions, understanding others, accepting them... and moving on to the future together...」

758:t_1:23.en:
$$トライア$$
「If you've grasped the truth, all that's left is to act on it.」

758:t_1:24.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「So that crystal is the gate itself.」

758:t_1:25.en:
$$エスター$$
「An adventure across dimensions, full of dreams and romance, huh...」

758:t_1:26.en:
$$トライア$$
「How about it, $$クロウ$$? Why don't you dream of striking it rich and sign up as a Gate Traveler?」

758:t_1:27.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Pass. I won't rely on that kind of gamble. I'll just keep paying off my debt, one step at a time.」

758:t_1:28.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「How much do you have left? I heard it once dropped below 500,000 G...」

758:t_1:30.en:
$$エスター$$
「It's gone up, hasn't it!」

758:t_1:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It can't be helped... Repairing the damage the $$リ・ブラスタ$$ took in the last battle cost a lot of money.」

758:t_1:32.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well... no helping it. That machine was about to be scrapped as no longer needed, and you're the one who asked to have it repaired.」

758:t_1:33.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I haven't sunk so low that I'd abandon my partner.」

758:t_1:34.en:
$$トライア$$
(I like that about you, you know... That's why the lab covered 80% of the expenses.)

758:t_1:35.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「But now that the fighting is over and there are no $$次元獣$$s left, how will you pay off the debt...」

758:t_1:36.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I've been thinking about all kinds of things. Becoming a mercenary, putting together an acrobatic team...」

758:t_1:37.en:
$$トライア$$
「Take your time thinking it over. For now, at least, the fighting is over.」

758:t_1:38.en:
$$トライア$$
「If you really can't think of anything, I'll keep sending you work from the lab like before.」

758:t_1:39.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「There's also the option of joining the Mars colonists.」

758:t_1:40.en:
$$エスター$$
「Why not work with me as an assistant in $$次元力|lc$$ research? That'd be good too, wouldn't it?」

758:t_1:42.en:
$$トライア$$
「Having hope is fine, but don't forget about that figure of 1,000,000 G.」

758:t_1:43.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The world may change, but I don't change... huh...」

758:t_1:45.en:
$$クロウ$$
(A future and peace full of hope... If the possibilities are infinite, I can even pay back a 1,000,000 G debt, I'd say...)

758:t_1:46.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Though I don't know when that'll be...)
